nodes.title: 共享负面提示词 (FLUX 留空)
九大境界批量出图说明 (含真仙共10个)
widgets_values:
■ 工作流: 修真境界图标批量生成 (FLUX)
   一次 Queue Prompt 出全部 10 张
   预计耗时 50-60 分钟 (M4 Pro)

■ 境界序列 (从低到高):
   1. 炼气 Qi Refining (lvl 1-10)
   2. 筑基 Foundation Building (lvl 11-20)
   3. 金丹 Golden Core (lvl 21-30)
   4. 元婴 Nascent Soul (lvl 31-40)
   5. 化神 Spirit Transformation (lvl 41-50)
   6. 返虚 Void Reverting (lvl 51-60)
   7. 合道 Dao Unity (lvl 61-70)
   8. 大乘 Great Vehicle (lvl 71-80)
   9. 渡劫 Heavenly Tribulation (lvl 81-90)
  10. 真仙 True Immortal (lvl 91-99)

■ 风格一致性策略:
   1. 10 个 KSampler 共享同一 seed (88888888)
   2. 共享 EmptyLatent (相同噪声起点)
   3. 共享 FLUX 模型 + BRIA 模型
   4. 提示词模板统一,只换 SUBJECT + COLOR
   5. 所有 control_after_generate = fixed

■ 输出 (每境界 2 份):
   output/wuxia_realm_1024/[name].png
   output/wuxia_realm_128/[name].png

■ 视觉演进设计:
   前期(1-3): 凝实有形 (能量/石塔/金丹)
   中期(4-6): 形神兼修 (有人形剪影出现)
   后期(7-10): 道法自然 (太极/莲花/雷劫/飞升)
   配色从朴素 -> 神圣金光

■ 出图后如何调整:
   场景 A: 10 张整体都不满意
     -> 改共享 EmptyLatent 噪声/换 seed
        然后整批重抽

   场景 B: 某一张单独不满意 (如真仙)
     -> 找到该境界的 KSampler 节点
     -> 把 seed 改成别的数 (如 88888889)
     -> 把 control_after_generate 暂时改 randomize
     -> 单独 Queue Prompt 重抽该境界
     -> 满意后改回 fixed

   场景 C: 主体方向偏差大
     -> 修该境界的正面提示词节点的 SUBJECT 部分

■ 命名规范 (与代码对齐):
   文件名采用简化 snake_case, 无 realm_icon_ 前缀
   将由 import_ai_assets.sh 自动回流到
   assets/ui/realm_icons/

■ 提示词改动只需改两处:
   - SUBJECT (主体描述)
   - COLOR PALETTE (配色)
   其他通用部分务必保持一字不差!

nodes.title: 1. 炼气 Qi Refining - 正面
widgets_values: A minimalist game UI icon for a cultivation RPG, centered composition. Subject: a single thin spiraling wisp of energy curling gracefully around a small glowing pearl in the center, the wisp forming one and a half turns around the central orb, suggesting a beginner cultivator gathering raw spiritual energy from the air. The subject occupies about 65 percent of the canvas in the center, with generous empty space around. Behind the subject is a complete unbroken single closed circular gold ring border drawn as a full 360 degree circle, uniform thin line weight all the way around, completely symmetric, no decoration on the ring itself. Pure clean solid white background, no other elements. Flat vector illustration style, painted with traditional Chinese ink wash brushstrokes but extremely simplified for icon use. Soft sky blue and warm pale white color palette only, with a subtle inner glow at the central pearl, the wisp slightly translucent. No realistic human portraits, only stylized silhouettes if any, no complex patterns, no maze patterns, no ornate frames, no text, no multiple subjects, no snowflakes, no frost decoration, no leaves on border, no debris on border, no asymmetric elements, no broken ring. Single focal point on the central pearl. Designed to be readable when scaled down to 64x64 pixels. Symmetric and balanced composition. Highest quality concept art for game UI.
